description:
The process of Vacations Request starts when any employee of the organization submits a vacation request.
Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the vacation.
The supervisor must approve or reject the request.
If the request is rejected, the application is returned to the applicant / employee who can review the rejection reasons.
If the request is approved a notification is generated to the Human Resources Representative, who must complete the respective management procedures.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor" processRef="Process_Supervisor"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_HumanResources" name="Human Resources Representative" processRef="Process_HumanResources"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReceive" name="Registered request" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_ReturnToReview" name="Rejected application" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_NotifyToComplete" name="Approval notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SubmitRequest" name="Vacation request submission">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed" name="Rejection reasons reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToRegister" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReceiveRequest" name="Vacation request registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestApproved" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyHumanResources" name="Generate notification to Human Resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return application with rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotificationGenerated" name="Notification generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReturned" name="Rejection returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToReceive" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToDecide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToNotify" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToReturn" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources" targetRef="EndEvent_NotificationGenerated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReturned"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_HumanResources" name="Human Resources Representative" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NotificationReceived" name="Approval notification available">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToComplete" sourceRef="StartEvent_NotificationReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
